description: Kajabi Smart Tools - Enhanced analytics, bulk operations, and export capabilities for Kajabi Knowledge Commerce Platform

tools.name: kajabi_member_analytics
tools.description: 📊 SMART ANALYTICS: Comprehensive member analytics with multiple output formats (summary/detailed/CSV) and Google Sheets export. Similar to gmail_bulk_read_summarize - analyzes all members, provides insights, and optionally exports to Google Sheets. Token-efficient 'summary' format shows key metrics only. Use when you need member statistics, enrollment trends, or want to export member data.

status_filter.description: Filter members by status: 'active', 'inactive', 'trialing', or null for all members

include_product_access.description: Include product access details for each member (requires additional API calls, default: true)

output_format.description: Output format: 'summary' (token-efficient, key metrics only), 'detailed' (full member data), 'csv' (export-ready format)

export_to_sheets.description: Create Google Sheets with results (requires Google Sheets access, default: false)

returns.description: Analytics data with optional spreadsheet_url. Summary format: {total_members, by_status, top_products, recent_signups}. Detailed format includes full member array. CSV format includes csv_data string.

examples.description: Get member statistics in token-efficient format
Export all active members to Google Sheets
Get member list as CSV for further processing

tools.name: kajabi_product_performance
tools.description: 📈 SMART ANALYTICS: Product performance analysis with enrollment metrics and export. Analyzes all products, counts enrolled members per product, and provides performance insights. Supports summary (top products only), detailed (all products), and CSV formats. Can export to Google Sheets for reporting.

include_member_count.description: Count enrolled members per product (requires additional API calls to members endpoint, default: true)

include_revenue_data.description: Include revenue metrics if available (future enhancement, default: false)

export_to_sheets.description: Create Google Sheets with product data (default: false)

returns.description: Product performance metrics. Summary: {total_products, top_products[{name, type, member_count, id}]}. Detailed includes full product array. CSV includes csv_data string.

examples.description: Export all products with member counts to Google Sheets

tools.name: kajabi_bulk_member_operations
tools.description: 🔧 BULK OPERATIONS: Perform actions on multiple members at once. Supports: grant_access (grant product access), revoke_access (remove product access), add_tag (add tag to members), remove_tag (remove tag). Processes all members in batch with success/failure tracking. Use when you need to update many members simultaneously.

member_ids.description: List of member IDs to perform operation on

product_id.description: Product ID (required for grant_access and revoke_access operations)

tag.description: Tag name (required for add_tag and remove_tag operations)

offer_id.description: Optional offer ID for grant_access operation

returns.description: Operation results: {operation, total_members, successful, failed, results[{member_id, success, error?}]}

examples.description: Add VIP tag to premium members
Remove access from list of members

tools.name: kajabi_export_to_doc
tools.description: 📄 EXPORT TO GOOGLE DOCS: Create formatted Google Doc with Kajabi data. Exports member lists, product lists, or comprehensive analytics reports to Google Docs with proper markdown formatting. Creates professional reports suitable for sharing with team members or stakeholders.

content_type.description: Type of content to export: 'member_list' (member report with stats), 'product_list' (all products with enrollment), 'analytics_report' (comprehensive analytics)

title.description: Document title (default: auto-generated based on content type and date)

include_member_count.description: For product_list: include member enrollment counts (default: true)

examples.description: Export product list with enrollment stats
